description: What people are SEARCHING FOR on Pinterest right now — Pinterest Trends, from the connected Pinterest account (no ad account needed). kind:"keywords" (default): the top 50 trending searches in a market by trendType growing (rising fast this quarter), monthly, yearly or seasonal, filterable by interests, ages, genders and includeKeywords, each with week / month / year growth in search volume. kind:"topics": the featured trend topics with example Pins. kind:"product_categories": the fastest-growing SHOPPING categories (verticals FASHION / HOME_DECOR / BEAUTY). kind:"product_category_details": demographics and trend lines for named categories. Use it to plan seasonal content and Pin titles. Growth is relative search interest, never a count of people. Read-only, 0 credits.

account.description: which connected account: its @handle or id from list_connector_accounts; needed only when several are connected

ages.description: age bands to filter keyword trends by, e.g. 25-34

engagementType.description: engagement measure to report: ENGAGEMENT, OUTBOUND_CLICK or SAVE

genders.description: keywords: male, female, unknown. product categories: MALE, FEMALE, UNSPECIFIED

includeDemographics.description: true = include demographics in the result

includeKeywords.description: keywords: only trends containing one of these (max 50)

interest.description: topics: ALL, ANIMALS, ARCHITECTURE, ART, BEAUTY, DIY_AND_CRAFTS, EDUCATION, EVENT_PLANNING, FASHION, FOOD_AND_DRINKS, GARDENING, HEALTH, HOME_DECOR, PARENTING, TRAVEL, WEDDING

interests.description: keywords: animals, architecture, art, beauty, childrens_fashion, design, diy_and_crafts, education, electronics, entertainment, event_planning, finance, food_and_drinks, gardening, health, home_decor, mens_fashion, parenting, quotes, sport, travel, vehicles, wedding, womens_fashion

kind.description: what to list: keywords (default), topics, product_categories or product_category_details

productCategories.description: product_category_details: category names from product_categories, e.g. AREA_RUGS

region.description: keywords: US, CA, DE, FR, ES, IT, DE+AT+CH, GB+IE, IT+ES+PT+GR+MT, PL+RO+HU+SK+CZ, SE+DK+FI+NO, NL+BE+LU, AR, BR, CO, MX, MX+AR+CO+CL, AU+NZ. topics / product categories: US, GB+IE, CA. Default US; "UK" means GB+IE.

verticals.description: shopping verticals for product categories: FASHION, HOME_DECOR or BEAUTY

name: pinterest_trends
title: Pinterest Trends
